messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to talk with me today. I’m really excited to learn more about your barbershop and how we can help with the digital booking system. To start off, could you tell me what your main goals are for this new booking system?

Well, I think it would be nice if customers could book their appointments online whenever they want. That would take some pressure off me. And, you know, having a way for them to reschedule or cancel without needing to call would be helpful, too. Just, you know, making things a bit easier for everyone.
That sounds great! So, just to clarify, you want customers to be able to book online anytime, and also have the option to reschedule or cancel their appointments without calling. Is that correct?
Yeah, that's the gist of it. It would save me some back-and-forth on the phone, which can be a bit of a hassle. Just having those options available online would be good.
Got it! So, having those online options would really help reduce phone calls for you. What about managing the schedules of your barbers? How do you see that working with the new system?

Well, I think it would be important for each barber to manage their own schedules. They should be able to set their availability, you know, when they're working or taking a break. It just makes sense for them to have control over that.
That makes sense! So, you’d like each barber to have control over their schedules and set their own availability. Can you provide an example of how you envision this working?

I mean, I guess it would be helpful if they could just log in and update their hours or time off whenever they need to. That way, it’s all up to them, and I wouldn’t have to manage it all myself. It should just be straightforward, really.

Okay, so you’re thinking that barbers should be able to log in and update their hours or time off easily. That sounds straightforward! Are there any limitations or restrictions you think we should consider for this digital booking system?
I haven't really thought about that much. I guess just making sure there's no double booking would be important. But other than that, I'm not sure what else to mention right now.

Got it! So, ensuring that there's no double booking would be a key limitation to keep in mind. Just to confirm, you want each barber to manage their own schedules online, and you also want customers to be able to book, reschedule, or cancel their appointments without calling. Is that right?
Yes, that sounds about right. Just keeping things simple for everyone involved, I think.

Perfect! So, to summarize what we've discussed so far: 

1. Customers should be able to book appointments online at any time.
2. Customers should have the option to reschedule or cancel their appointments online.
3. Each barber should be able to manage their own schedules and set their availability.
4. Barbers should be able to log in and update their working hours or time off easily.
5. The system should prevent double booking to avoid conflicts in appointments.
